meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 它会为新用户主持第一次对话:依次带你看 omo 的功能、可选地把旧代理的配置迁过来、翻查你以前的历史会话、按日志估算缓存能省多少,途中随手把了解到的信息写进记忆,最后提议运行 init-deep。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想上手 omo 时触发;首次会话自动运行一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 手动唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我走一遍。
say.note: 它会依次走六个环节的引导

say.text: 我以前用 Claude Code,能把配置迁过来吗?
say.note: 先给你一份迁移方案,等你确认再动手

say.text: 帮我看看我以前的会话,估算一下能省多少。
say.note: 翻查历史会话并按 Senpi 日志算缓存节省

howto.what_en: It runs a new omo user's first conversation: a feature tour, optional migration of setup from another coding agent, past-session mining, caching-savings estimates, ongoing memory writes, and a first-session init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo; it auto-starts once ever, and can be brought back later with the senpi --onboard flag.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo — walk me through it.
say_en.note: It runs the six-lane guided flow.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code; can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: It shows a plan and waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Look through my earlier sessions and estimate the savings.
say_en.note: It mines sessions and computes caching savings.
